description: This file defines a PHP class 'DateRange' within the OrangeHRM project, representing a date range with optional start and end dates. It includes constructors, getters, and setters for managing 'from' and 'to' date properties.

classes.name: DateRange
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) class representing a range of dates with optional 'from' and 'to' DateTime properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new DateRange instance with optional 'from' and 'to' DateTime values.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Retrieves the 'from' date of the range.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the 'from' date of the range.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Retrieves the 'to' date of the range.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the 'to' date of the range.
